3:7.hebrew: וְעַל־יָדָם הֶחֱזִיק מְלַטְיָה הַגִּבְעֹנִי וְיָדוֹן הַמֵּרֹנֹתִי אַנְשֵׁי גִבְעוֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּה לְכִסֵּא פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר׃
3:7.english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah made repairs for the seat of the governor of Beyond the River.
3:7.editorial_note: The Hebrew says ‘for the seat’ or ‘for the throne.’ Rashi reads a physical seat for the governor. The phrase has also been understood as referring to the governor’s jurisdiction. See https://www.chabad.org/library/bible_cdo/aid/16510/jewish/Chapter-3.htm.

3:38.hebrew: וַנִּבְנֶה אֶת־הַחוֹמָה וַתִּקָּשֵׁר כָּל־הַחוֹמָה עַד־חֶצְיָהּ וַיְהִי לֵב לָעָם לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
3:38.english: So we built the wall, and it was joined together all the way around, up to half its height, for the people put their hearts into the work.
3:38.editorial_note: This is Nehemiah 4:6 in conventional English numbering. The Hebrew says the whole wall was joined ‘to its half,’ understood here as half its height.

11:16.hebrew: וְשַׁבְּתַי וְיוֹזָבָד עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה הַחִיצֹנָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים מֵרָאשֵׁי הַלְוִיִּם׃
11:16.english: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the leading Levites, were in charge of the outside work for the house of God.

11:20.hebrew: וּשְׁאָר יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם בְּכָל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ׃
11:20.english: The rest of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, lived throughout the towns of Judah, each on his own inheritance.

11:21.hebrew: וְהַנְּתִינִים יֹשְׁבִים בָּעֹפֶל וְצִיחָא וְגִשְׁפָּא עַל־הַנְּתִינִים׃
11:21.english: The Nethinim lived on the Ophel, with Ziha and Gishpa in charge of them.

11:28.english: in Ziklag, and in Meconah and its dependent towns,

11:35.english: Lod, Ono, and the Valley of Craftsmen.
